scientific_question: Can the exact production directed-product family encode both dense c_fc temporal-state tensors inside one procedural-coordinate allowance per family, despite generic low-rank and sparse rejection?

interpretation_contract.why_this_precedes_a_replay: A time-conditioned state code must at least represent the terminal state. Testing the exact procedural family at the terminal checkpoint can reject an expensive optimizer-state trajectory replay without retraining.
interpretation_contract.optimistic_upper_bound: Each state family receives the full production coordinate count separately. Supports are selected using the dense answer and their index storage is ignored.
interpretation_contract.pass: Both state families pass the aggregate and every-late-layer gates. This authorizes only one paired temporal optimizer-state acquisition and a chronological causality analysis; it does not authorize a compact optimizer or language-model candidate.
interpretation_contract.fail: At least one family fails even this answer-conditioned oracle. The actual directed-product family cannot encode the dense temporal state at the registered budget, so no trajectory replay or compact-state implementation is justified.
